en: Sepia postcard showing a long pergola-lined walkway along the castle pond, with trees, a railing, and people strolling; swans are visible in the water. Caption at front reads "Bad Pyrmont – Rosengang am Schloßteich." Reverse has German handwriting, a postmark from Bad Pyrmont, an 8 Pf 'Deutsches Reich' Beethoven stamp, and a printed logo "Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont." Addressed to Herbert Herzog in Schmiedeberg i. Erzgebirge.
